S01-L001.speaker: NARRATOR
S01-L001.text: Once upon a time, at the edge of a wide and peaceful forest, there lived a little mouse who loved exploring.

S01-L002.speaker: NARRATOR
S01-L002.text: The mouse knew every berry bush, every hollow log, and nearly every winding path beneath the trees.

S01-L003.speaker: NARRATOR
S01-L003.text: One afternoon, the mouse wandered farther from home than usual.

S01-L004.speaker: NARRATOR
S01-L004.text: There had been so many wonderful things to eat — tiny seeds beneath the tall grass, sweet berries beside the stream, and one particularly delicious acorn that took much longer to enjoy than expected.

S02-L001.speaker: NARRATOR
S02-L001.text: By the time the mouse finally looked up, the golden afternoon light had begun to fade.

S02-L002.speaker: NARRATOR
S02-L002.text: The shadows beneath the trees were growing longer.

S02-L004.speaker: NARRATOR
S02-L004.text: Still holding the acorn, the mouse stood up. Then the little traveler set it carefully beside a stone at the stream.

S03-L001.speaker: NARRATOR
S03-L001.text: Home was still quite a distance away.

S03-L002.speaker: NARRATOR
S03-L002.text: There were two ways to get there.

S03-L003.speaker: NARRATOR
S03-L003.text: One was the familiar path that curved safely around a sunny meadow.

S03-L005.speaker: NARRATOR
S03-L005.text: It cut straight through a quiet part of the forest that the mouse rarely visited.

S03-L006.speaker: NARRATOR
S03-L006.text: The mouse looked at the darkening sky.

S03-L010.speaker: MOUSE
S03-L010.text: I'll be home before the stars come out!

S04-L005.speaker: NARRATOR
S04-L005.text: The mouse ran faster and faster, thinking only of getting home.

S05-L001.speaker: NARRATOR
S05-L001.text: What the mouse did not notice was the enormous lion sleeping beneath a great old tree.

S05-L002.speaker: NARRATOR
S05-L002.text: His mane rested against the grass.

S05-L004.speaker: NARRATOR
S05-L004.text: And one enormous paw stretched directly across the path.

S05-L008.speaker: NARRATOR
S05-L008.text: The mouse tripped over the lion's paw.

S05-L009.speaker: NARRATOR
S05-L009.text: There was a tumble, a roll, and a very surprised little mouse landed right against the lion's enormous nose.

S05-L011.speaker: LION
S05-L011.text: What in the forest was THAT?

S06-L001.speaker: NARRATOR
S06-L001.text: The lion lifted his head in surprise. The mouse scrambled down onto the path.

S06-L002.speaker: NARRATOR
S06-L002.text: Before the mouse could scramble away, one enormous paw came down beside the tiny traveler, blocking the path.

S06-L004.speaker: NARRATOR
S06-L004.text: Only moments earlier, getting home before dark had seemed like the biggest problem in the world.

S06-L005.speaker: NARRATOR
S06-L005.text: Suddenly, it did not seem very important at all.

S07-L001.speaker: LION
S07-L001.text: You woke me from the finest nap I've had all week.

S07-L002.speaker: LION
S07-L002.text: Why were you racing through here without watching where you were going?

S07-L003.speaker: MOUSE
S07-L003.text: I'm sorry! I was eating by the stream, and I didn't notice how late it had become.

S07-L004.speaker: MOUSE
S07-L004.text: I took a shortcut because I wanted to get home before dark.

S07-L005.speaker: MOUSE
S07-L005.text: I wasn't trying to disturb you. I promise.

S08-L003.speaker: NARRATOR
S08-L003.text: He could easily have frightened the little creature even more.

S08-L005.speaker: NARRATOR
S08-L005.text: After all, he was the strongest animal for miles around.

S08-L006.speaker: NARRATOR
S08-L006.text: But being able to frighten someone did not mean that he had to.

S08-L009.speaker: LION
S08-L009.text: you certainly chose an exciting shortcut.

S08-L011.speaker: LION
S08-L011.text: And next time, look where you're running.

S08-L015.speaker: LION
S08-L015.text: I see no reason to hurt you for that.

S08-L016.speaker: NARRATOR
S08-L016.text: The mouse stared up at the lion.

S08-L017.speaker: NARRATOR
S08-L017.text: Anger was what had been expected.

S08-L018.speaker: NARRATOR
S08-L018.text: Instead, the lion had chosen kindness.

S08-L021.speaker: MOUSE
S08-L021.text: I hope someday I can show someone the same kindness.

S08-L024.speaker: LION
S08-L024.text: Those stars you were worried about are almost here.
